summary: Keep conflicting GitHub observation receipts incremental instead of replaying the whole graph

replay.detail: Graph-neutral claim kinds, including github.event and message.sent, reconcile operation receipts through the existing indexed canonical reducer only when every stored claim and checkpoint tombstone for that operation is graph-neutral. Missing operation rows also fold checkpoint tombstones. Mixed-kind histories involving a graph-projecting claim retain the full-replay guard so naming and other structural projections remain canonical. No migration replay is required.

schema.detail: No schema, index, trigger, claim or signature changes. Uses the existing operations row and reducer.

rules.detail: Canonical operation selection, conflict outcomes, checkpoint tombstones and repaired-claim exclusions retain the full replay's existing meaning. Regression coverage admits received envelopes and asserts both claims arrived and the operation actually transitions to conflict before comparing full-replay digests.

compatibility.detail: No registry, wire or client changes. Signed claims and idempotency keys are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Normal binary restart only; no coordinated fleet interruption is required.

manual.detail: No live replay, database edit, heal or reset is requested.

recovery.detail: Older binaries read the same canonical operation rows and retain their former full-replay guard. No irreversible format change.
